evidence: The change only edits the S17 acceptance prose and appends the L25 log entry in the feature document.

I traced the new regex `(^|[^\w.-])gentle-ai([^\w/-]|$)` by hand against the claimed cases. It matches bare, `sh -c 'gentle-ai x'`, `&& gentle-ai`, `/usr/local/bin/gentle-ai` and `|gentle-ai`. It does not match `gentle-ai-overlay`, `~/.gentle-ai/y` or `/opt/gentle-ai/bin/foo`.

The acceptance now covers every command-bearing value, which resolves the earlier hook-only narrowing. It also requires the parent to read each match, which covers the `echo gentle-ai` false positive.
I found no defect that this commit introduces.
